parsed.notes:
Anforderungsprofil sets required qualifications; idealerweise makes only the cloud environment and its AWS example optional.
Deployment-Prozessen is interpreted as AI deployment in the context of the AI-engineering qualifications.
Speech AI is broader than speech recognition and has no exact taxonomy entry, so it remains unmapped.
AI Engineer and ML Engineer are role titles in the experience requirement, not separate technical-skill asks.
RAG and model training appear only under responsibilities and are excluded.
